settings.thread_tag: Tag for "show what you got" discussions
settings.thread_tag_help: The tag an organizer's "show what you got" discussion is started in. Without one, only members who may skip tag rules can start it.

permissions.moderate: Run any Secret Santa exchange (edit, draw, handle dropouts, reveal a match)

page.title: Secret Santa
page.lead: Sign up, get matched with a secret giftee, and send something nice. Only you know who you drew.
page.load_error: The exchanges could not be loaded. Please try again.

card.drawn: Matched, waiting to be sent out

exchange.missing: This exchange doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
exchange.join_help: Add your wishlist and how to get a gift to you. Sign-ups close {time}.
exchange.log_in_to_join: Log in to join this exchange.
exchange.confirm_email_to_join: Confirm your email address to join this exchange. Check your inbox for the link.
exchange.you_are_in_help: When sign-ups close, everyone is matched at random. You'll get a notification saying who you're buying for.
exchange.drawn_waiting: Matches have been drawn. You'll be told who you're buying for when the organizer sends them out.
exchange.leave_confirm: Leave this exchange? Your wishlist and note will be deleted.
exchange.your_note_digital: How to send you a gift
exchange.note_private: Only the member who draws you will see this, and only after matching.

entry.wishlist_placeholder_physical: Things you like, sizes, hobbies, what you'd rather not get…
entry.wishlist_placeholder_digital: Games you want, your Steam or store wishlist link, art you'd love…
entry.wishlist_help: Your Secret Santa sees this once you're matched. You can change it any time.
entry.note_digital: How to send you a gift (private)
entry.note_placeholder_physical: Name and address to ship to, and anything the carrier needs.
entry.note_placeholder_digital: Your Steam friend code, gift email, or where to send art.
entry.note_help: Visible only to the member who draws you, and only after matching. Not even organizers can read it.
entry.exclusions_help: A partner or roommate, for example (up to {count}). Neither of you will draw the other. Everyone must keep at least 3 people they could be matched with, so in a small exchange this may have to wait until more have joined.
entry.joined: You're in! We'll tell you who you're buying for when sign-ups close.

form.title: Name
form.kind_help_physical: Members ship a gift. Each one adds a private shipping note that only their Santa sees.
form.kind_help_digital: Steam keys, gift cards, art trades and the like. Members say how to send them a gift instead of an address.
form.rules_placeholder: What counts, what doesn't, handmade welcome, regions you ship to…
form.hold_reveal: Let me look over the draw before matches are sent
form.hold_reveal_help: Otherwise everyone is told who they're buying for as soon as sign-ups close. You never see the pairs either way.
form.unmask: Show everyone who their Santa was when the exchange ends
form.unmask_help: Each member then sees who sent their gift, and nobody else's. This can't be changed after sign-ups close.

giving.no_note: They didn't add a note. Send them an anonymous question below.
giving.ship_title: Your gift is on its way?
giving.ship_intro_physical: Your giftee is told their gift has shipped, but not who sent it.
giving.ship_intro_digital: Your giftee is told their gift was sent, but not who sent it.
giving.gift_note_placeholder_physical: A tracking number, or "Open it on the 25th!"
giving.gift_note_placeholder_digital: A Steam key, gift link, or where to find your art. Only your giftee sees it.

receiving.title: Your gift
receiving.waiting: Your Santa had to drop out. The organizer is finding you a new one.
receiving.thanks_placeholder: Your Santa reads this; they won't know you saw who they are.

notes.empty_giving: Need a size, a color, or a store region? Ask here: they won't see who's asking.
notes.empty_receiving: Your Santa can ask you questions here without revealing who they are.

organizer.title: Organizer tools
organizer.delete_confirm: Delete this exchange? Every entry, match and note in it is deleted too.
organizer.state_open: Sign-ups close {time}. Matches are drawn automatically then.
organizer.draw_error_too_few: Sign-ups closed with fewer than 4 members, so there was no draw. Move the deadline to let more people join.
organizer.draw_error_busy: Matches couldn't be found this time, though they may exist. Try drawing again.
organizer.draw_error_exclusions: There's no way to match everyone with these exclusions. Remove a pair, then draw again.
organizer.state_drawn: {count, plural, one {# match is} other {# matches are}} ready. Nobody can see them, you included. Send them out, or draw again.
organizer.waiting: {count, plural, one {# member is} other {# members are}} waiting for a new Santa.
organizer.draw_early_confirm: Close sign-ups now and draw matches?
organizer.finish_confirm: End the exchange? Gifts can still be marked as received afterwards.
organizer.finish_confirm_unmask: End the exchange? Everyone will see who their Santa was.
organizer.start_thread: Start a "show what you got" discussion
organizer.sent_hidden: Who has sent their gift shows from {date}. Any sooner, and it could be lined up with who drew whom.
organizer.dropout_confirm_drawn: Remove {name}? Matches will be drawn again.
organizer.dropout_confirm_active: Remove {name}? Their giftee gets a new Santa picked at random, their own Santa is let off, and nobody learns who was matched.
organizer.rescue_confirm: This member will buy an extra gift. You'll know this one pair. Continue?
organizer.peek_intro: Only for sorting out a problem. Every organizer sees a log of who looked, at whose match, and why.
organizer.exclusions_help: Pairs who must not draw each other, either way round.

notification.shipped: Your Secret Santa sent your gift!
notification.message_from_santa: Your Secret Santa sent you a note
notification.news_ended: The exchange is over. Thanks for taking part!
notification.news_released: Your giftee left the exchange, so you don't need to send a gift.
notification.news_removed: You were removed from the exchange.
notification.news_draw_failed: Matches couldn't be drawn for your exchange.

errors.secret_santa_bad_exchange: Check the name (3 to 100 characters), the rules and the budget.
errors.secret_santa_bad_dates: Sign-ups must close in the future (within a year), and the send-by date can't be before that.
errors.secret_santa_bad_note: Add a shipping note so your Santa can send you a gift.
errors.secret_santa_closed: Sign-ups for this exchange are closed.
errors.secret_santa_wrong_state: That can't be done at this stage of the exchange.
errors.secret_santa_draw_too_few: At least 4 members are needed to draw.
errors.secret_santa_draw_busy: Matches couldn't be found this time, though they may exist. Try drawing again.
errors.secret_santa_too_few_left: That would leave fewer than 4 members, and then people could work out their Santa. End the exchange instead.
errors.secret_santa_exclusions_tight: That would leave someone with fewer than 3 people they could be matched with, which could give their Santa away. Remove another pair first, or wait until more people have joined.
errors.secret_santa_ship_by_later: Once sign-ups have closed, the send-by date can only move later.
errors.secret_santa_draw_exclusions: There's no way to match everyone with these exclusions. Remove a pair and try again.
errors.secret_santa_bad_pair: Choose two different members of this exchange.
errors.secret_santa_bad_member: That member can't be chosen for this.
errors.secret_santa_too_long: That's too long (1,000 characters at most).
errors.secret_santa_slow_down: That's a lot for one day. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.secret_santa_reason_needed: Give a reason (it goes in the log).
errors.secret_santa_thread_exists: The discussion has already been started.
errors.secret_santa_tag_denied: You can't start discussions in the tag set for these.
errors.secret_santa_needs_tag: An admin needs to choose a tag for these discussions first.

thread.title: Show what you got: {title}
thread.body:
The {title} gift exchange is under way! 🎁

Got your gift? Show it off here and thank your Santa.

[See the exchange]({url})

gdpr.export: Your Secret Santa entries, matches you gave to, and notes you wrote.
gdpr.delete: Your Secret Santa entries and matches.

matched.subject: Secret Santa: you're buying for someone in {title}
matched.body:
Hi {recipient_display_name},

The draw for **{title}** is done. You're Secret Santa for **{giftee_display_name}**!

Their wishlist and where to send your gift are waiting for you, and only you: [open the exchange]({url}).

Keep it secret! 🎁
matched.plain:
Hi {recipient_display_name},

The draw for {title} is done. You're Secret Santa for {giftee_display_name}!

Their wishlist and where to send your gift are waiting for you, and only you:
{url}

Keep it secret!

shipped.subject: Secret Santa: your gift is on its way ({title})
shipped.body:
Hi {recipient_display_name},

Your Secret Santa in **{title}** has sent your gift! 🎁

[Open the exchange]({url}) to see any note they left, and mark it received when it arrives.
shipped.plain:
Hi {recipient_display_name},

Your Secret Santa in {title} has sent your gift!

Open the exchange to see any note they left, and mark it received when it arrives:
{url}

message.subject_santa: Secret Santa: a note from your Santa ({title})
message.body_santa:
Hi {recipient_display_name},

Your Secret Santa in **{title}** sent you a note. [Read it and reply]({url}): they stay anonymous.
message.body_giftee:
Hi {recipient_display_name},

**{giftee_display_name}** replied to your note in **{title}**. [Read it]({url}).
